title: ALMOST READY — An Animated Short Film
creative_target: cinematic story-led stick-figure short about perfectionism and fear of being seen
renderer: H2 SelfImprove Studio native Canvas/Chromium + FFmpeg audio mastering

story.hook: He was always one revision away.
story.counter: EDITS rises while SHARED remains 0; the deadline visibly reaches 0
story.turning_point: A real friend asks to see the work, so he shares an imperfect version
story.end_card: RELEASE. / Finished can find its people. / Let it leave your hands.

render.artifact_storage: Run #11 is retained as a technical baseline; run #13 adds a readable portfolio folder prop and keeps the seated café pose

latest_technical_pass.targeted_visual_review: Reviewed contact sheets and 1 fps motion proof montages for portfolio sharing, send confirmation, seated café feedback and receding shadow; café characters remain seated during the point gesture.

known_limits: The H2 character and prop rig must be verified in the rendered scene; source assertions do not establish visible contact.
The laptop/phone UI templates are stylized inserts; review text readability at 1920x1080.
The complete film must be watched with audio before artistic approval.
